extDescription.message: Shows your bookmarks in Chrome's side panel, synced peer-to-peer from a local syncd instance — no central server.

portHint.message: The port your local syncd is listening on, e.g. 47100 (see syncd --port).

authTokenPlaceholder.message: Only if syncd was started with --auth-token

authTokenHint.message: Leave blank if your syncd instance doesn't require one.

crawlToggleHint.message: When a page's title/image can't be read directly (side panel "+" button, or a right-click on a link), fetch the page itself in the background to fill them in. Grants access to read pages on any site you bookmark.

statusSaved.message: Saved! Open the side panel to see your links.

fetchErrorText.message: Couldn't reach the local sync service. Check the port and token in settings.

addCurrentTabTitle.message: Add this page to Reading List

addCurrentTabCommand.message: Add current tab to Reading List

notifyErrorBody.message: The local sync service rejected the link. Try again or check your settings.

notifyInvalidBody.message: This tab doesn't have a valid http/https URL.

notifyNotConfiguredBody.message: Open the extension settings to set your local syncd port.

notifyDeleteErrorBody.message: The local sync service rejected the request. Try again later.
